scope: +X arm only: original Quadri exterior faces divided into three rigid solid-section armor parts, an original-source-derived flexible sleeve, four pose keys and transition diagnostics

mode_inference_decision.rationale: The approved original checkpoint Quadri polygon indices define the visible armor surface. Only crossing faces and recessed caps are newly modeled; sleeve contours come from the same original mesh.

art_contract.coordinate_system: canonical X-left-right, Z-up, +Y-front, 1.86 m whole-character scale
art_contract.solid_section: Each concave cut is closed by planar constrained ear triangles, with no parallel inner shell or centroid fan; shoulder and wrist caps are provisional attachment boundaries
art_contract.rigidity: Each armor mesh has one 100% weighted bone; sleeve stations have separate controls
art_contract.overlap_exception: Sleeve is intentionally recessed beneath armor lips. Any visible cap, metal intersection, z-fight, or continuous background seam fails visual QA.
art_contract.source_detail_policy: The three armor exteriors retain 56/71/153 complete original Quadri polygons and 66/64/60 polygons clipped at joint planes; high-poly normal bake is a separate later task. Diagnostic materials are not final textures.

failed_gates: Elbow armor and forearm have 49 strict triangle crossings at bend90 and 37 at combined; sampled intermediate frames reach 93.
Joint rim/cap crossings remain and several intermediate frames include true exterior-surface crossings.
The elbow sleeve bulges in bend renders; joint caps and cloth/metal visibility need further local modeling and camera review.
approval_gate: Mechanical and visual QA plus independent review; not an approved or published character
